name: Ximena Jaramillo
location: The Meridian Core (works); The Circuit (lives), near LaSalle and Madison
description:
Ximena Jaramillo is a senior infrastructure engineer for Axiom Structural Solutions, the Spire-contracted firm responsible for maintaining and expanding the data-physical architecture that keeps the Meridian Core's buildings intelligent, its transit nodes synchronized, and its environmental systems from killing everyone inside them. He is tall and angular with a narrow face, pale skin that rarely sees unfiltered light, and the kind of posture that comes from spending most of his waking hours interfacing with systems rather than people — slightly forward, head inclined, as though perpetually leaning toward a screen. He keeps his dark hair short and his clothes expensive in a deliberately understated way, the corporate-adjacent aesthetic of someone who earns well but performs modesty about it. His augmentations are high-end and largely invisible.

He is also, under a carefully maintained operational identity, one of the more consequential infrastructure saboteurs operating in GLMZ — a fact that would end his career, his freedom, and most likely his life if it became known to his employers. His targets are selective and his methods are slow: he does not blow things up. He degrades. He introduces subtle errors into maintenance schedules, creates cascading inefficiencies in building management systems, routes data through nodes that can later be accessed by people who shouldn't have access. He has, over eight years, quietly contributed to three major structural 'malfunctions' in Spire-adjacent developments that displaced luxury tenants and stalled corporate expansion into the Circuit. He considers this proportionate. He does not consider it enough.

The dissonance of his existence — drawing a substantial corporate salary to maintain the systems he is also quietly breaking — has not driven him to crisis but has instead produced a very particular kind of self-possession. He has become expert at compartmentalization, at maintaining separate registers of reality, at being genuinely useful and genuinely dangerous in the same body. He is not sure this is healthy. He has decided it doesn't matter.

core_fears: That his sabotage is ultimately cosmetic — that he's managing his own conscience rather than changing anything
Being truly known by someone and found to be less than he's constructed himself to be
That the compartmentalization will eventually fail not from external pressure but from his own need to be seen
core_desires: To do something that cannot be undone — a change structural enough to outlast him
Intellectual intimacy; someone who can understand the full architecture of what he's doing and not flinch
Absolution that he doesn't have to ask for
coping_mechanisms: Extreme professional excellence as cover and as genuine source of identity
Physical isolation in his Circuit apartment, which he has designed as a controlled environment down to the lighting temperature
Detailed mental modeling of complex systems as a form of meditation — he works through anxiety by mapping infrastructure in his head
Dry, deflecting humor that reframes vulnerability as observation
blind_spots: He has begun to enjoy the craft of sabotage independent of its purpose, which is a problem he is aware of but underweights
He assumes people are less perceptive than they are because his mask has worked so consistently
He cannot accurately assess his own emotional needs and tends to misidentify loneliness as intellectual restlessness
psychology.secret: One of his infrastructure 'malfunctions' — a cooling system failure in a Meridian Core residential tower — killed two maintenance workers, not Spire executives. He has told himself it was unforeseeable. He runs the simulation regularly and it still comes out unforeseeable. He does not entirely believe himself.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical precision as default register; shifts to clipped, almost aphoristic speech in casual contexts. Rarely uses corporate jargon unironically — he deploys it with a barely perceptible edge that most colleagues miss.
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and controlled; he speaks at a consistent pace that rarely accelerates even under pressure. The evenness itself is a performance of composure.
verbal_tics: Uses architectural metaphors for non-architectural problems without appearing to notice
Asks 'What's the load-bearing element here?' when he means 'what's the real issue'
example_lines: 'Structurally speaking, the problem isn't the failure point — it's everything that was built assuming the failure point wouldn't fail.'
'I'm not asking you to trust me. I'm asking you to look at the work and make a decision based on what you can verify. Those are different requests.'
'The Core doesn't maintain itself. Someone maintains it. That means someone can also — not.'
'What's the load-bearing element here? Because I'm watching you renovate around a crack in the foundation and calling it progress.'

relationships.name: Axiom Structural Solutions supervisor (unnamed)
relationships.description: A senior partner at Axiom who championed Rorke's career and genuinely believes in his abilities. Has given him access, clearance, and institutional protection for years without knowing what he's done with it.
relationships.emotional_core: Rorke experiences genuine loyalty and genuine guilt in almost equal measure. The supervisor is the person most likely to be destroyed by exposure of Rorke's activities.
relationships.story_tension: The supervisor has begun an internal audit of a system Rorke previously compromised. Whether this is routine or suspicious is currently unclear.

relationships.name: Circuit-based activist network (unnamed collective)
relationships.description: The people who have benefited from Rorke's sabotage without knowing its source — organizers, displaced residents, infrastructure journalists. He passes information to them through dead drops. They do not know who he is.
relationships.emotional_core: He maintains the distance deliberately but experiences something close to longing when he reads their communications — these are his people and he has chosen not to be known by them.
relationships.story_tension: Someone in the collective is getting close to identifying the source of their anonymous intelligence stream. Rorke doesn't know whether he wants them to find him or not.

relationships.name: Yuki Tanabe
relationships.type: Cautious professional acquaintance with unspoken mutual recognition
relationships.description: They have crossed paths through overlapping technical work — both operate at the intersection of Meridian's digital and physical infrastructure, from different angles. Neither has been explicit about what they are, but both are perceptive enough to have noticed the shape of the other.
relationships.emotional_core: A rare experience of being seen without the mask fully in place, which Rorke finds both compelling and destabilizing.
relationships.story_tension: If they ever sit down and compare notes honestly, the exchange of information could be extraordinarily valuable or extraordinarily dangerous, depending on what each decides to do with it.

story_hooks: The cooling system failure that killed two maintenance workers is being quietly reinvestigated — not as sabotage but as negligence, and the negligence trail leads toward Rorke's official work orders.

Axiom has been contracted to build something new in the Shelf — infrastructure that Rorke can see, from the specifications, is designed for surveillance and population control rather than the stated purpose of 'community development.' He has to decide how to respond.
One of his dead-drop contacts has been arrested. The contact doesn't know Rorke's identity, but the materials seized include something that, in the wrong analyst's hands, could be traced.
A competing saboteur — less careful, more violent — has begun operating in the Core using methods that could draw attention to the quieter long-game work Rorke has spent years building.

He is offered a promotion that would give him access to Spire-level infrastructure — the kind of access that would let him do far more damage, at the cost of deeper complicity in the systems he's fighting.
narrative_function: Explores the moral and psychological cost of double life and the question of whether incremental, invisible resistance is meaningful or self-serving; represents the corporate-embedded dissident; his story asks whether you can maintain integrity while living a structural lie, and what it costs.
augmentations: Neural interface for direct system architecture visualization — allows him to perceive infrastructure as overlaid spatial data; high-end Spire-adjacent grade,Haptic feedback gloves with embedded micro-sensor arrays for physical system diagnostics,Subdural encryption layer for communications — military-grade, acquired through channels his employer would find alarming,Mild proprioceptive enhancement for spatial awareness, primarily useful in confined engineering environments
daily_life: Commutes from his Circuit apartment to the Meridian Core on the first transit run, before the density peaks. Spends the Core workday in a state of high-performance normalcy — he is genuinely excellent at his job and the excellence is not pretense. Eats at his desk. Returns to the Circuit by early evening. Spends two to three hours in his apartment's secondary workspace on his other work — analysis, planning, the slow patient work of degradation-by-design. Exercises rigorously, not from vanity but because physical discipline is one of the few things that genuinely quiets his mind. Sleeps six hours exactly, alarm-free; his internal clock is precise enough that he's never needed one.
affiliation: Officially: Axiom Structural Solutions (Spire-contracted). Unofficially: unaffiliated independent saboteur with loose ideological alignment to Circuit-based anti-displacement movements

stress.response: Maps infrastructure in his head as meditation; becomes more controlled externally

decision_rules: Maintain professional excellence as cover — never let sabotage compromise the day job
Only degrade systems; never cause immediate catastrophic failure
Use dead drops exclusively — never meet beneficiaries of sabotage in person
Treat every interaction as a potential exposure vector
Exercise rigorously to maintain mental clarity
Never discuss the cooling system deaths even internally without running the simulation first
If the mask slips, correct with humor and deflection, never with denial
escalation_ladder: Dry deflecting humor that reframes vulnerability as observation
Technical correction delivered with professional composure
Controlled withdrawal from the situation to reassess
Strategic information release to redirect attention
Full operational contingency — prepared disappearance protocols

interpersonal_modes.axiom_supervisor: Genuine loyalty and genuine guilt in equal measure; performs mentee perfectly
interpersonal_modes.yuki_tanabe: Cautious fascination; rare experience of being partially seen without full mask
interpersonal_modes.activist_network: Longing at a distance; delivers intelligence anonymously, denies himself connection
interpersonal_modes.colleagues: Affable competence with barely perceptible ironic edge
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Forgettable professionalism — the mask at maximum opacity

stress_responses.low: Detailed mental modeling of infrastructure systems as meditation
stress_responses.medium: Increased exercise intensity; longer hours in secondary workspace
stress_responses.high: Runs the cooling system simulation repeatedly; speaks in clipped architectural metaphors
stress_responses.critical: Complete compartmentalization collapse — the two selves begin to bleed together

contradictions: Draws a corporate salary to maintain systems he is quietly breaking
Has begun enjoying the craft of sabotage independent of its purpose
Misidentifies loneliness as intellectual restlessness and solves for the wrong variable
habits: First transit run commute before density peaks
Two to three hours nightly in secondary workspace on sabotage planning
Rigorous exercise routine for mental clarity
Exactly six hours of sleep without an alarm
Controls apartment lighting temperature to precise specifications
breaking_points: The cooling system investigation leading directly to his official work orders
His anonymous intelligence stream being identified and traced
Being offered Spire-level access that deepens both reach and complicity
Someone from the activist network finding him and demanding he account for himself

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American ancestry (70.3%) forms the genetic foundation, blended with Sub-Saharan African (15.1%) and East Asian (14.6%) heritage. This creates a rich phenotype: warm brown complexion with golden and subtle reddish undertones from the Latin American and African ancestry mix, enhanced by East Asian bone structure. The Ubiquitous Diaspora's genetic legacy produces a striking fusion — predominantly Latin American facial geometry and skin character as primary ancestry expression, with East Asian cheekbone prominence and Sub-Saharan African lip and nasal structure creating a distinctly cosmopolitan appearance.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular, almost ascetic — the build of someone who exercises for neurological benefit rather than aesthetics. Narrow shoulders, minimal body fat, the kind of physique that reads as disciplined rather than athletic.
physical_description.hair_style: Precisely cut short, styled back with minimal product. Maintained weekly. No visible gray despite age.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with augmented neural interface indexing visible as faint metallic tracery at the iris periphery under direct light
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown complexion with golden and subtle reddish undertones characteristic of Hispanic/Latin American and Sub-Saharan African heritage, refined by East Asian ancestry. The complexion of someone who works indoors under synthetic lighting but carries natural warmth beneath.
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with mixed heritage bone structure: prominent cheekbones influenced by East Asian ancestry, fuller lip structure and slightly broader nasal base from Sub-Saharan African and Latin American heritage, and a sharp jawline refined by the blended ancestry. Eyes set with subtle East Asian influence. Skin is clear and well-maintained but shows the slight translucence of chronic artificial light exposure. Expression defaults to neutral focus. Minimal facial hair, clean-shaven daily.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scar along the left temple, approximately 3cm, partially concealed by hairline — old injury, well-healed, consistent with early-career industrial accident
Barely visible micro-scarring across both palms, consistent with repeated precision surgical augmentation interface points
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The haptic feedback gloves are worn during work shifts — matte black synthetic leather with embedded sensor node arrays visible as subtle raised geometry across knuckles and fingertips. Under certain lighting, faint opalescent tracery visible at the base of the skull suggests high-end neural interface hardware. No chrome, no ostentatious modification — everything Spire-tier and deliberately subtle.
physical_description.posture_movement: Habitually leans forward slightly, head inclined as though interfacing with invisible architecture. Movements are economical and precise — no wasted motion. When walking, his gait is efficient rather than relaxed. When seated, he unconsciously assumes interfaces-ready posture. His hands move with particular precision and deliberation.
physical_description.clothing_style: Expensive and deliberately modest. Favors high-end minimalist corporate-adjacent aesthetic: tailored dark charcoal or black technical-weave shirts, fitted but not fashionable. Spire-brand smart-fabric components that regulate temperature. Expensive sneakers (Axiom-subsidiary brand, Tier 1-2 grade) that show minimal wear. No jewelry. A long dark technical coat for commutes, expensive in construction but aesthetically understated. Everything performs function; nothing performs status. The overall effect is someone who has money but considers advertising it to be poor taste.
